title: 宝塚記念の後に・『つまんない』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky wins the Takarazuka Kinen. She now has further confidence that exhaustive thinking will lead her to victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sensing her rivals' intense stares from behind, she worries they'll use this loss as further motivation to improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All of this has become so played out, she complains—or is something else on her mind?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heeds King Halo's directive and decides to run in the autumn Tenno Sho next. An uneasy summer begins…
